description: Source code for CodeMirror mode for CSS and related preprocessors, defining syntax highlighting and parsing rules.

classes.name: Context
classes.description: Represents a parsing context with type, indentation, and previous context.

methods.name: tokenBase
methods.description: Tokenizes the base CSS syntax elements from the stream.

methods.name: pushContext
methods.description: Pushes a new parsing context onto the stack.

methods.name: popContext
methods.description: Pops the current parsing context from the stack.

methods.name: pass
methods.description: Delegates tokenization to the current context's state.

methods.name: wordAsValue
methods.description: Classifies a word token as a value type.
